**Is your suggestion related to a problem? Please describe.**
The visuals, tapping, and music are not in sync on some devices. 
This would result in sometimes tapping being registered when at the center of cranky and the circles spreading out too much. Also, tapping often lags when on bounces, causing trouble for players who rely on music and visuals to play the taps. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Another calibration option that allows syncing the visuals with the music, one similar to that in Rhythm Doctor. This should be used alongside with the tapping calibration, so that it would be a better experience to get our hands on tapping with the music.  

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Another solution is similar to what they implemented in A Dance of Fire and Ice, that there is a single calibration screen that controls the shift of the visuals and input. This enables the hitsounds to be in sync with our input sounds, providing a better experience. 

**Additional context**
I am submitting this request because I have a lot of trouble figuring out when to tap. They often result in too earlies (misses) and too lates (misses). This issue frustrates me a lot so if the visuals, audio tracks, and tapping time window are in sync, this would be a much better experience for newcomers to this excellent game. 




**By submitting this, I am confirming that I have read the [README](https://github.com/DPS2004/Beatblock-issues/blob/main/README.md) and am using the latest version of Beatblock.**
